cohort: All source-verified files and exactly the earliest nonoverlapping supported pauses in the independently verified input census. Do not replace zero-event pauses.
theta_phase_smoothing: Pinned source: unwrap Hilbert phase, convolve with normalized odd-width Gaussian kernel of approximately ten sigma, wrap to [-pi, pi).
theta_spectral_rule: A native contiguous RUN bout supports theta only when its raw-LFP Welch peak within 4-14 Hz is in 7-11 Hz and its mean theta power density exceeds the adjacent-band mean by at least 1.5. Short or unusable bouts remain unsupported; band-pass phase alone never establishes theta.
theta_reference_rule: Use the input census's lowest numbered non-bad downsampled CA1 channel per annotated hemisphere; no outcome/power selection.
run_bins: Whole bins anchored to the native tracking start, wholly contained in one matched native position link. Never concatenate across tracking gaps or unmatched intervals. Retain zero-spike bins.
mua_baseline: Mean and population SD of smoothed curated-CA1 population counts in all tracking-supported immobile bins at <=4 cm/s in that file. Exclude the smoothing guard at gaps and recording edges.
mua_boundary: Contiguous immobile run above the baseline mean, with peak strictly above mean+3SD; no gap merging.
candidate_eligibility: Inherit all PF order-measurement duration, eligible-spike and eligible-unit thresholds unchanged. Events must be wholly inside a frozen pause. Eligibility uses only units selected from preceding matched RUN.
order_and_shuffles: Use the exact frozen PF equal-width whole-event bins, normalized signed 5-60 ms pair order, and 20 whole-bin population-vector permutations.
scope: Measured LFP theta, matched RUN spike/covariate banks, and candidate pair-order controls. No RUN-coordination-change association is authorized yet.
claim_boundary: Theta spectral QC is a screening check, not proof of unbiased phase or camera hardware latency. Curated CA1 clusters are not assumed pyramidal. Candidate bursts are not validated replay. PF missing-theta and historical negative stopgates remain unchanged.
